plan.reason: The forecast predicts a cold day with temperatures dropping significantly below freezing. To ensure that zones do not overheat, especially given the warmest zone at 21.0 C and considering the forecast's coldest hour will be -9.5 C, setting the supply air temperature ceiling to 12.8 C is necessary. This ensures that even on the coldest day of the forecast, the zones are not pushed into cooling mode unnecessarily.
